title: Ambrym, Southeast Language (TVK)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Southeast Ambrym is a stable indigenous language of Vanuatu. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
